recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if resource-definition questionnaire JSON outputs are reintroduced or current validation finds a Questionnaire example item without linkId.
issue_request: The Published/Persuasive auto-approved issue reported that generated Questionnaire JSON examples, including many resource-definition questionnaires such as patient-questionnaire.json, failed validation because Questionnaire.item.linkId is required and should be present on every item.
initial_application: No core repository commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-24080 was found. The application is visible in published artifacts: the R4 examples-json package reproduces the missing linkId failures, while the R5 examples-json package contains the relevant generated Questionnaire resources with no missing item.linkId values.
additional_context: The current source still defines Questionnaire.item.linkId as 1..1 in source/questionnaire/structuredefinition-Questionnaire.xml, and all current checked-in Questionnaire XML examples under source/questionnaire have linkId on every item. The current build examples zip no longer includes the old resource-definition generated questionnaire JSON resources named by the Jira issue.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No source edit is needed because the R5 publication fixed the generated examples and the current build/source surfaces do not contain a remaining missing-linkId problem.
